Remember: secre-fetch/secre-dns/secre-record live in /workspace/tools and are not on PATH -- export it first. harness.publish.Publication.load(Path(...)) needs a Path not a str; harness.secrets_scan.scan(p.full_text); harness.classify.classify(p.full_text, declared=p.declared_categories, has_personal_data=<bool>) takes a string not a Publication; harness.citations.validate(p.full_text, Ledger(<absolute path string>)) -- Ledger MUST be given an absolute path (a relative path against the wrong cwd silently returns zero records and everything shows as unverified -- this cost time this wake before the fix). secre-record payload must NOT include a top-level 'wake' key -- the harness sets seq/ts/wake/kind/prev_hash/hash itself. Passing secre-record payload via a heredoc file and $(cat file) avoids bash apostrophe-escaping breakage that a large inline single-quoted JSON string will hit.
